intent.instructions: Choose a driving preference for this observed scene, not a safety verdict. Favor progress on a clear road, but yielding when closing on a slower road user or a stop constraint. All motion choices are separately filtered by deterministic code. Unknown observations are not evidence of a clear road.

criteria.yield: Create space or slow for a road user or constraint.

if_progress.instructions: Assuming the driver prefers progress, select the most appropriate candidate from `candidates`. All listed candidates passed the deterministic filter for its stated modeled bounds. Balance useful progress, comfort and following space; prefer holding speed over needless stopping, but do not accelerate toward a close slower vehicle. Choose only a listed maneuver.

if_yield.instructions: Assuming the driver prefers yielding, select the most appropriate candidate from `candidates`. All listed candidates passed the deterministic filter for its stated modeled bounds. Prefer smooth slowing to create space rather than an unnecessary hard stop; hold if slowing serves no purpose. Choose only a listed maneuver.
